tools.name: create_payout_plan
tools.description: Validate a bounded stablecoin payout run (recipients, budget, time window) and return an approve-once pack the OWNER approves in their own wallet. RailFi never holds funds or keys and does not execute payments.

tools.name: validate_payout_plan
tools.description: Check a payout plan for bad addresses, bad amounts, duplicates, inverted window and over-budget totals.

tools.name: reconcile_payouts
tools.description: Match on-chain transfer records (recipient, amount, txHash) to plan lines and report which invoices are paid, unpaid, or unexpected transfers.

tools.name: fetch_transfers
tools.description: Read-only: look up public USDC/USDT Transfer events to the given recipients (optionally from one payer) over up to 10000 recent blocks via a public RPC. Output plugs straight into reconcile_payouts. No keys, no signing.
